question: Which sprinter broke his own national 200 m record with a run of 20.02 seconds in Ostrava?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gout Gout**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Gout Gout** is a rising **Australian** sprinting sensation who has gained international attention for his incredible speed in the **200m** and **100m** events. 
• The **16-year-old** athlete recently made headlines by clocking a remarkable **20.02 seconds** (and previously **20.29 seconds**) in the **200m** sprint, significantly breaking **national junior records**. 
• His performance in **Ostrava** at the **World Athletics Continental Tour** or similar high-profile meets has solidified his reputation as one of the fastest teenagers in history. 
• Born in **Ipswich, Queensland**, to **South Sudanese** parents, he is often compared to the legendary **Usain Bolt** due to his tall stature, late-race acceleration, and dominant running style. 
• His record-breaking run at such a young age places him among the elite **Under-20 (U20)** sprinters globally, challenging times set by established world-class athletes. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Reynier Mena:** 
• **Reynier Mena** is a prominent **Cuban** sprinter known for his explosive speed in the **100m** and **200m**. 
• He made history in **July 2022** at the **Ostrava Golden Spike** meet by running the **200m** in **19.63 seconds**, which is one of the fastest times ever recorded in the event. 
• **Lamine Yamal:** 
• **Lamine Yamal** is a world-renowned professional **footballer** who plays as a right-winger for **FC Barcelona** and the **Spain national team**. 
• He is famous for breaking numerous "youngest player" records in football, including at **UEFA Euro 2024**, but he is not a track and field athlete. 
• **Victor Lopez:** 
• **Victor Lopez** is a respected figure in the world of athletics, serving as the **President** of the **Association of Pan-American Athletics (APA)**. 
• He is better known for his **coaching** and administrative contributions to the sport rather than being an active record-breaking sprinter. 
• **The 200m Sprint:** 
• The **200 meters** is a classic sprint event in athletics that requires a combination of **curved-track technique** and **straightaway speed**. 
• The **World Record** for the **200m** is held by **Usain Bolt**, who clocked **19.19 seconds** at the **2009 World Championships** in **Berlin**. 
• Major meets like the **Ostrava Golden Spike** (founded in **1961**) serve as vital platforms for athletes to achieve **Olympic** and **World Championship** qualifying standards. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **National and International Context:** 
• **Gout Gout** represented **Australia** at the **2024 World Athletics U20 Championships** in **Lima, Peru**, where he won the **silver medal** in the **200m**. 
• His rapid progression suggests he will be a key contender for the **2028 Los Angeles Olympics** and the **2032 Brisbane Olympics**. 
• The emergence of young talents like **Gout Gout** and **Erriyon Knighton** (USA) signals a highly competitive era for the **200m** discipline. </ul
